messages:
jules: Quick sync — preparing a canary for phoenix-v2a. Hit two blockers: 1) manifest -> weights checksum mismatch (bundle renamed?), 2) tokenizer is inserting an extra leading token which causes the toolcall sentinel to be missed in structured outputs. Can folks confirm weight path + tokenizer behavior? :eyes:

maria: I pulled the manifest and bucket. The canonical bundle moved to s3://redwood-models/phoenix/v2a/phoenix_v2a_weights.tar.gz — manifest still points at s3://redwood-models/phoenix/v2/weights.tar.gz. I'll replace the manifest entry and push a new sha256 checksum in ~10m. Uploaded a re-export candidate tokenizer_v2b.bin to the same folder for testing.

raj: When I staged the model the config linter failed: 
```n$ python infra/tools/lint_model_config.py --model phoenix-v2a
ERROR: schema error: unknown field `token_offset` in `tokenizer`
```
Looks like the onboarding config uses legacy `token_offset`. New schema expects `tokenizer.trim_leading` (boolean). I'll add a small compatibility shim that maps the old field -> new. Will open a PR.

sophie: Golden regression CI showing structured-output mismatches. Quick example from goldens/phoenix_v2a.json: 
```nexpected: { "tool_calls": [{"name":"search"}], "response": {"text":"..."} }
actual: { "response": {"text":"Found results..."} }
```
Model is dropping the `tool_calls` envelope when the tokenizer adds a prefix token, so our sentinel-detection in the eval harness misses the tool call.

sam: To run locally (prints per-case diffs):
```n./tools/run_regression.py --model phoenix-v2a --goldens goldens/phoenix_v2a.json --mode full --force-toolcall --output /tmp/phoenix_reg.log
```
Add `--smoke` for a quicker run. I'll start a full run from my workstation and post the fail list.

raj: PR #5488 created: backward-compat mapping for `token_offset` -> `tokenizer.trim_leading` plus unit tests for the mapping. cc @maria @sophie for quick review. :thumbsup:

maria: Manifest + checksum updated and pushed. New checksum (sha256): `3a7f9c2d...`. Re-exported tokenizer at s3://redwood-models/phoenix/v2a/tokenizer_v2b.bin — drop it into models/phoenix/tokenizer.bin locally to test. Console link: https://s3.console.aws.amazon.com/buckets/redwood-models/phoenix/v2a/

sophie: Kicking local goldens now. I see ~3 failing cases out of 240 so far, mostly the toolcall wrapper missing. As a temporary measure I'm adding a small normalizer in the eval harness to synthesize `tool_calls` when text contains the CALL sentinel so tests don't block the canary. Will upload diffs to /artifacts/phoenix-v2a/gold-diffs.tar.gz.

sam: Running regtests here. Logs will be at /logs/regtests/phoenix-v2a/2101234567.log — I'll paste failing test ids as they complete. If anyone needs to reproduce: use my run command above.

deploy-bot: Canary pipeline note: canary job queued (canary-7934) but blocked until manifest, lint, and goldens checks pass.

jules: Rollout gates (explicit):
- manifest points to correct bundle and checksum verified
- config lint passes (no unknown fields)
- golden structured-output regression <= 1% failures
- function/toolcall smoke all pass
- perf p95 <= 200ms on canary pool
If those are green we start a 10% canary and monitor for 1 hour.

sophie: Temporary eval normalizer implemented under infra/eval/normalizers/extra_prefix_normalizer.py (not merged to main, used locally). Will remove once tokenizer_v2b is validated and in the bundle.

raj: Addressed review comments on #5488, will merge once CI is green. Lint should be unblocked after this mapping.

maria: I fixed one flaky golden case (edge sentinel with punctuation). Pushed updated golden and re-uploaded a tiny patch to tokenizer_v2b that trims the problematic byte in decode. Please re-run.

jules: Thanks all — I'll wait for the CI green and regtest output, then kick the canary. Ping here when your runs finish and paste the regtest log path. :heart:
